# dev_pause

Configure Ethernet PAUSE frames (flow control) on a network device.

Uses `ethtool -A` to enable or disable RX and TX pause frames on the
specified interface.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut dev_pause PAUSE=on
```

Source: [`modules/dev_pause.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/dev_pause.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PAUSE` | `off` | Enable or disable pause frames: on or off |
| `NIC` | `0` | NIC index to configure |
